entries.notes: Verified norm conjugate domains, quadratic completion, dual data signs, recovery map and strong-convex primal uniqueness/dual compact attainment.
Verified scalar negative-log infimum including nonpositive multiplier exclusion, nullspace equality, stationarity, exact dual value and unbounded-domain alternatives.
Verified every scalar quadratic effective-domain case, equality-multiplier sign, elimination at mu=abs(c+A^T lambda), exact box-LP dual and infeasibility case.
Verified multiplier 2 alpha residual, global convex Lagrangian stationarity, and lower bound with twice the penalty term rather than a primal upper bound.
Verified increasing-convex composition, nonnegative derivative multipliers, global stationarity and evaluated dual lower bound without strong-duality assumptions.
Verified auxiliary multiplier budget, Slater construction, strict alpha threshold proof for every optimizer and equality-threshold counterexample.
Verified support-LP dual signs, nonempty uncertainty assumption, dual attainment when support finite and infinite-support exclusion, with exact outer projection.

Verified strict polyhedral separation via positive attained distance of closed difference, exact LP dual signs and unit-gap normalization. Author added requested constructive empty-set cases: both empty, one proper nonempty, and nonempty full-space impossibility for a genuine normal.
Verified threshold LP certificate including ties, dual sign/effective domain, explicit auxiliary optimizer and floor-zero diversification case.
Verified entropy conjugate, equality multiplier signs, common-shift elimination using column sums, information-radius expression and zero-row dual nonattainment handling.
